p: If you are not a body, what are you? Ask this in honesty
r: Miracles are seen in light. Let me not close my eyes because of this.
ev: Three times today, set aside about ten minutes for a quiet time in which you try to leave your weakness behind.
Five or six times an hour, at reasonably regular intervals, remind yourself that miracles are seen in light.

p: Closing the body's eyes and asking truth to show us how to find the meeting place of self and Self, where light and strength are one.
ev: Let us give twenty minutes twice today to join this meeting.
Morning and evening we will practice thus.
Let us repeat as often as we can the idea for today

len: the first five minutes of every waking hour
p: Put away your foolish self-images, and spend the rest of the practice period in trying to experience what God has given you
r: Light and joy and peace abide in you.
ev: In our longer exercise periods today, which would be most profitable if done for the first five minutes of every waking hour
At least remember to repeat these thoughts each hour:

len: the first five minutes of each waking hour
p: Today we will again devote the first five minutes of each waking hour to the attempt to feel the truth in you.
r: You are as God created you.
ev: If you do not meet the requirement of practicing for the first five minutes of every hour, at least remind yourself hourly:
Tell yourself frequently today that you are as God created you.

p: I am one Self, united with my Creator, at one with every aspect of creation, and limitless in power and in peace.
r: You are one Self with me, united with our Creator in this Self.
ev: We will, therefore, keep to the five-minutes-an-hour practice periods for a while
Repeat today's idea as frequently as possible

p: Salvation comes from my one Self. Its Thoughts are mine to use.
ev: Every time you spend five minutes of the hour seeking Him Who joins your mind and Self

p: Spirit am I, a holy Son of God, free of all limits, safe and healed and whole, free to forgive, and free to save the world.
ev: The Holy Spirit will be glad to take five minutes of each hour from your hands
Practice this truth today as often as you can

p: Each hour today give Him your tiny gift of but five minutes.
ev: Each hour today give Him your tiny gift of but five minutes.
Repeat today's idea while you wait for the glad time to come to you again. Repeat it often

p: Think of these things in practicing today
r: Salvation is my only function here.
ev: Remind yourself of this between the times you give five minutes to be shared with Him Who shares God's plan with you.

p: Look deep within you, undismayed by all the little thoughts and foolish goals you pass as you ascend to meet the Christ in you.
ev: Do not forget the idea for today between your hourly practice periods.
